sentences.text: Heard the counsel for the petitioner.

The present petition has been filed for the following reliefs:-
"(i) to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned FIR dated 19.01.2025 in Case Crime No.0031 of 2025 Under Section 376,
504, 506 I.P.C. Police Station-Kotwali, District-Mainpuri,
(ii) to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding /directing the Respondent No.2 not to arrest the Petitioner in Case Crime No.0031 of 2025 Under Section 376, 504, 506 I.P.C. Police Station-Kotwali District-Mainpuri during the investigation."
It has been stated by the A.G.A. that a final report has been filed in the aforesaid case.
In view of the aforesaid, the writ petition is dismissed
